name: wm
description: WhiteMagic meta-tool — memory and continuity kernel over the curated tool surface (70 tools): persistent memory, session continuity and recall, governance/audit, and local tool execution.

arguments.name: args
arguments.desc: Arguments to pass through to the target tool.

arguments.name: route
arguments.desc: Explicit tool name for direct dispatch (e.g. 'memory.create', 'tools.list').

arguments.name: thought
arguments.desc: Natural language input describing what to do. Auto-routes to the best-matching tool via TF-IDF NLU classification.

name: memory.create
description: Store a new memory in the holographic memory core with 5D spatial coordinates and galaxy routing.

arguments.name: event_time
arguments.desc: Optional event time: when the recorded event actually happened, as RFC 3339 (epoch seconds are also accepted at runtime). Absent = not tracked; never inferred from write time.

arguments.name: importance
arguments.desc: Optional importance 0.0-1.0 (write gate applies class ceilings/floors when the class is recognized)

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Authorship claim: user (user-dictated content, trust 1.0) | agent (default, trust 0.7) | other free-form class (trust 0.7)

arguments.name: topic
arguments.desc: Optional topic label for subject-scoped retrieval (envelope v2)

name: memory.search
description: Search memories: hybrid BM25 + vector fusion with deterministic episodic and full-text fallbacks; each result discloses its recall_mode. The preferred recall tool.

arguments.name: cold_scan_limit
arguments.desc: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

arguments.name: galaxy
arguments.desc: Galaxy filter (optional; default: search all memory galaxies, results labeled; "all" is accepted as an alias for the unfiltered default)

arguments.name: include_cold
arguments.desc: Opt-in unranked cold recovery (no thaw). Trust/importance floors apply; BM25 floors do not apply to unscored recovery. Search content is scrubbed navigation capped at 8192 characters; read by id/galaxy for the exact original.

arguments.name: min_score_ratio
arguments.desc: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

arguments.name: min_trust
arguments.desc: Minimum source_trust (0-1): drop results below this trust floor

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Inclusive lower time bound: RFC3339 ('2026-02-01T00:00:00Z') or epoch seconds

arguments.name: time_basis
arguments.desc: Time basis for since/until: 'recorded' (created_at, default) or 'event' (event_time, falling back to created_at when unset)

arguments.name: until
arguments.desc: Inclusive upper time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

name: memory.read
description: Retrieve a specific memory by its ID or coordinate address.

name: memory.list
description: List memories with filters (galaxy, tags, limit, offset) for browsing and discovery.

arguments.name: exclude_tags
arguments.desc: Drop memories carrying any of these tags

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Skip this many matching entries before returning (default 0)

name: memory.hybrid_recall
description: Compatibility alias of memory.search — same implementation, same arguments, same results. Kept for clients pinned to this name; prefer memory.search.

arguments.name: cold_scan_limit
arguments.desc: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

arguments.name: galaxy
arguments.desc: Galaxy filter (optional; default: search all memory galaxies, results labeled; "all" is accepted as an alias for the unfiltered default)

arguments.name: include_cold
arguments.desc: Opt-in unranked cold recovery (no thaw). Trust/importance floors apply; BM25 floors do not apply to unscored recovery. Search content is scrubbed navigation capped at 8192 characters; read by id/galaxy for the exact original.

arguments.name: min_score_ratio
arguments.desc: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

arguments.name: min_trust
arguments.desc: Minimum source_trust (0-1): drop results below this trust floor

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Inclusive lower time bound: RFC3339 ('2026-02-01T00:00:00Z') or epoch seconds

arguments.name: time_basis
arguments.desc: Time basis for since/until: 'recorded' (created_at, default) or 'event' (event_time, falling back to created_at when unset)

arguments.name: until
arguments.desc: Inclusive upper time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

name: session.record
description: Record a session turn (decision, breakthrough, summary) so the next session can resume.

arguments.name: supersedes
arguments.desc: Memory id of an earlier turn this record corrects/replaces (amend-with-supersede)

arguments.name: track
arguments.desc: Optional track slug (lowercase; a-z0-9 start, then a-z0-9-_. /) — tags this turn into that track's implementation log (session.track_log)

name: session.continuity
description: Recall where the previous session left off: recent turns, checkpoints, and open work.

arguments.name: include_briefing_text
arguments.desc: Include the ready-to-inject briefing.text block (default false; adds bytes outside the turns budget)

arguments.name: max_content_bytes
arguments.desc: Per-turn content cap in bytes (256-262144, default 8192)

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

arguments.name: until
arguments.desc: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

name: session.start
description: Start or resume an agent session for persistent continuity across tool invocations.

name: memory.update
description: Update an existing memory in place (content, tags, importance, title, topic); a content change appends to the memory's revision chain.

name: memory.revisions
description: List or verify a memory's content revision chain (tamper evidence): every content update is chained and head-checked.

name: session.checkpoint
description: Save a structured checkpoint (git state, next queue, open flags) so the next session can resume exactly here.

arguments.name: branch
arguments.desc: Manual branch name (auto-captured when git is available)

arguments.name: commit
arguments.desc: Manual commit hash (auto-captured from git when root/WM_PROJECT_ROOT is set)

arguments.name: data
arguments.desc: Legacy free-form passthrough stored beside the handoff.

arguments.name: lease_id
arguments.desc: Claimed scope (code.claim lease_id) that remains held at this handoff

arguments.name: next_queue
arguments.desc: Ordered next-step strings for the next session.

arguments.name: open_flags
arguments.desc: Open concerns/flags worth surfacing on resume.

arguments.name: root
arguments.desc: Repository root for auto git-capture (default: WM_PROJECT_ROOT env)

arguments.name: tests_green
arguments.desc: Whether the test suite was green at checkpoint time.

arguments.name: track
arguments.desc: Optional track slug — tags this checkpoint into that track's log (session.track_log)

name: memory.ingest
description: Harvest a folder of documents or session transcripts into the store (idempotent via a SHA-256 ledger; dry-run and redaction on by default).

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: Report without writing or creating the store (default true).

arguments.name: include_credential_files
arguments.desc: Ingest credential-named files with redaction (requires redact=true).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Only consider the first N files in walk order (0 = all).

arguments.name: redact
arguments.desc: Scrub credential-shaped content before storage (default true).

arguments.name: wait_secs
arguments.desc: Wait up to N seconds for a busy store before failing.

name: receipts.emit
description: Emit a signed continuity receipt (Ed25519 did:key): session evidence or a karma-chain-head attestation, verifiable offline.

arguments.name: out
arguments.desc: Optional path to also write the bundle JSON for external verification

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Session UUID (session kind; default: most recent session)

name: receipts.verify
description: Verify a receipt id or a bundle offline; fail-closed without an anchor (verdict PROVISIONAL).

arguments.name: bundle
arguments.desc: Inline bundle to verify (alternative to id)

arguments.name: require_anchor
arguments.desc: Fail-closed: without an anchor the verdict is PROVISIONAL

name: memory.count
description: Count memories matching optional filters without returning content.

arguments.name: galaxy
arguments.desc: Galaxy to count (optional; all memory galaxies when absent)

name: memory.stats
description: Memory index statistics: totals, galaxy spread, and index health.

name: memory.tags
description: List the tag vocabulary with usage counts.

arguments.name: galaxy
arguments.desc: Galaxy whose tags to list (optional; default codex)

name: memory.aggregate
description: Aggregate a numeric or categorical field over matched memories.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Full-text query selecting the memories to aggregate over

name: memory.associations
description: Associative neighbours of a memory (spreading activation over the association graph).

name: memory.batch_read
description: Read several memories by id in one call.

name: memory.query
description: Structured query over memories with filters and ordering.

arguments.name: created_after
arguments.desc: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z)

arguments.name: created_before
arguments.desc: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Case-insensitive substring filter over content (literal match). For tokenized, ranked full-text retrieval use memory.search

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: Filter: memories with all of these tags

name: memory.filter
description: Filter memories by metadata (tags, importance, recency).

arguments.name: created_after
arguments.desc: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z)

arguments.name: created_before
arguments.desc: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

arguments.name: exclude_tags
arguments.desc: Filter: drop memories carrying any of these tags

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Skip this many matching entries before returning (default 0)

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Filter: every whitespace-separated term must appear (case-insensitive) in the content or title

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: Filter: memories with all of these tags

name: memory.nearby
description: Memories near a coordinate address (5D spatial neighbourhood).

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Query text to locate in 5D space

name: memory.vector.search
description: Vector-similarity search over memory embeddings.

arguments.name: memory_id
arguments.desc: Memory UUID whose stored embedding is the query

name: session.list
description: List sessions with titles and summaries.

name: session.recall
description: Recall a session's turns without continuity packaging.

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Session UUID to recall (defaults to the most recent session)

name: session.replay
description: Replay a session's recorded turns in order.

arguments.name: include_superseded
arguments.desc: Also return turns replaced via supersedes (default false).

arguments.name: page_size
arguments.desc: Lossless mode records per page (1-64, default 16)

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Target session (required explicit UUID for lossless; otherwise default most recent)

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

arguments.name: turn_types
arguments.desc: Selective mode: turn types to keep

arguments.name: until
arguments.desc: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

name: gnosis.status
description: Knowledge-surface status: galaxies, counts, and index health.

name: gnosis.explain
description: Explain why a memory or route was selected (provenance readout).

arguments.name: args_hash
arguments.desc: Hash of the arguments under evaluation

arguments.name: has_purpose
arguments.desc: Claim: the invocation carries a purpose

arguments.name: is_network
arguments.desc: Claim: the invocation uses the network

arguments.name: is_spawn
arguments.desc: Claim: the invocation spawns a process
